description.en: Fork any session into a different agent preset from the conversation header: a preset-picker button that creates a new child session mounted on the chosen preset, inheriting the source session's completed turns.
description.zh: 在会话 Header 上一键把当前会话分叉到任意 agent preset：选择 preset 后创建挂载到该 preset 的新子会话，并继承源会话的已完成轮次。
